findings.title: Compound member writes bypass the unreviewed-mutation guard
findings.expected: OfficialSPReceiptError because the selected race is mutated after extracted JSON
findings.impact: Receipt bytes can describe a changed selected race while the parser returns the earlier selected race as source-bound. The member guard only recognizes a plain equals assignment.

findings.title: A later script may reset jsonData while previously extracted documents remain accepted
findings.expected: OfficialSPReceiptError because a reset after data assignment makes the embedded documents ambiguous/stale
findings.impact: Declaration ordering is only checked inside each script, but the extracted dictionary survives across scripts. Document-level mutation/reset invalidation is missing.

nonblocking_observations.title: Data scripts after the closed html element are accepted
nonblocking_observations.classification: Additional strict-markup concern; not independently required for the blocking assessment because HTML browser recovery can accept this placement.
